---
title: "Architecture"
---

## Single source of truth

The **`ikdds-etl`** package metadata is the canonical definition of every registry
field. All downstream documentation is generated from it, so it cannot drift from the
code that actually moves the data.

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
  DICT[ikdds-etl<br/>canonical data dictionary] --> DRS[DRS]
  DICT --> CRF[CRF]
  DICT --> DMP[DMP]
  DICT --> DASH[dashboard field mappings<br/>metrics.yml]
  DICT --> PKG[pkgdown reference]
  DRS & CRF & DMP & PKG --> HUB[This docs hub]
```

## Layers

1. **Source** — eMed SQL Server (clinical system).
2. **ETL** — `ikdds-etl` extracts, transforms to UKRR v5.1, loads to REDCap. Each of
   9 forms follows `extract_ → transform_ → load_ → etl_`.
3. **Registry** — REDCap.
4. **Reporting** — `ikdds-dashboard` (caterpillar/funnel plots, Wilson CIs, small-n
   suppression).
5. **Augmentation** — `ikdds-nlp` extracts coded fields from clinical notes.
6. **Stewardship** — `ikdds-data-management` runs QC, reconciliation, completeness.

## How this hub is built

This site is a [Quarto](https://quarto.org) website published to GitHub Pages. It links
to each repository's auto-generated `pkgdown` reference and renders the generated
specifications. Rebuilds are triggered when the ETL dictionary changes.
